fields.title: 3. Where It Reaches the Judgment Layer
fields.md:
### 3-1. T7 Path Table — Retroactive Check and Correction

This round, the path table was re-scanned for the entire period after the event start date (10/13). As a result, three letters addressed to the company turned out to be missing.

| Path | Sender → Recipient | Date sent | Deadline | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⓘ (retroactive) | Senators Shaheen, Blumenthal, Whitehouse and Coons → SpaceX VP of Legal Cardaci | 10/19 | 11/2 (6 questions + 3 record requests) | Deadline passed — no public response found | [Senate Foreign Relations Committee press release](https://www.foreign.senate.gov/press/dem/release/shaheen-blumenthal-whitehouse-and-coons-demand-answers-from-spacex-after-starlink-and-starshield-failure-leaves-ukraine-vulnerable-to-russian-attacks) |
| ⓓ2 (retroactive) | Blumenthal (Ranking Member, Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations) → SpaceX CEO | 10/22 | 11/5 (9 questions · records since 2026-01-01) · 11/12 (briefing by SpaceX officials) | Deadline passed — no public response found | [Letter PDF](https://www.hsgac.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026-10-22-Letter-from-Ranking-Member-Blumenthal-to-SpaceX.pdf) |
| ⓖ (retroactive) | Senators Welch, Schiff and Bennet · Representatives Meeks, McGovern and Crow → SpaceX CEO (cc: president and 7 directors) | 10/23 | 10/31 (5 questions) | Deadline passed — no public response found | [Letter PDF](https://www.schiff.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/starshield-letter-to-musk.pdf) |
| ⓗ (new) | Himes → SpaceX CEO · Director of National Intelligence | 11/20 | None | Pending | [CNN](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/trump-intel-chief-warned-no-184233055.html) |
| ⓕ (existing) | Senate Foreign Relations Committee Shaheen and Coons → SpaceX Chairman | 11/13 | 11/30 | Pending | [Letter PDF](https://www.foreign.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/11132026%20Letter%20to%20Elon%20Musk%20and%20SpaceX%20on%20Starshield%20and%20Starlink.pdf) |

- **Correction — 11/12 for ⓓ**: state had recorded 11/12 for ⓓ (Blumenthal → Secretary of Defense) as a 'SpaceX briefing'. On opening the original, what the letter to the Secretary of Defense (13 questions, 11/5) requested is a briefing by 'Department of Defense officials'. The 11/12 SpaceX briefing was a request in the letter sent to SpaceX on the same day (ⓓ2) (Sources: [Letter to Secretary of Defense PDF](https://www.hsgac.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026-10-22-Letter-from-Ranking-Member-Blumenthal-to-Hegseth.pdf) · [Letter to SpaceX PDF](https://www.hsgac.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026-10-22-Letter-from-Ranking-Member-Blumenthal-to-SpaceX.pdf)).
- **One sentence in the ⓖ letter**: The signatories cited the disclosure obligations of listed companies and raised the disclosure of governance, geopolitical and foreign-government-action risks. SpaceX's 10-Q and 8-K contain no mention of these letters (latest: 11/16 SC 13G/A) (Sources: [ⓖ letter PDF](https://www.schiff.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/starshield-letter-to-musk.pdf) · [EDGAR](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json)).
- **No response is not an event**: That there is no public response to the three letters past their deadlines (10/31 · 11/2 · 11/5 · 11/12) is recorded as 'not disclosed'. It does not mean they refused to respond (Source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T7].prev`).

### 3-2. T7 ③ (Candidate for Recurrence of Conflict Involvement) — Judgment Remains Pending

- Per protocol, we searched again this round. Since the 11/16 'day 7' post by chargé d'affaires Sienik and the 11/20 CNN report that 'Kyiv is in contact with the Defense Department, no response from SpaceX', we have found no new Starshield announcement by the Ukrainian government (searched 2026-11-22 KST). With neither official acknowledgment nor independent confirmation, judgment remains pending (Sources: [Interfax-Ukraine 11/16](https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/1237394-amp.html) · CNN 11/20 · `state.milestones[E-2027-3].progress.candidates`).
